title: Polarization and Morality: Lexical Analysis of Abortion Discourse on Reddit
reasoning: The paper uses the Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) and the Morality Foundation Dictionary (MFD) as its core methodology to analyze the abortion debate. It evaluates how pro-choice and pro-life groups utilize moral values (Harm/Care, Fairness/Cheating, Loyalty/Betrayal, Authority/Subversion, Sanctity/Degradation) and religious concepts (e.g., 'sin', 'church') in their discourse.
